zephyr_library()
# The frozen boot prefix lives at the module root, not under src/, because it is
# generated by extract_boot_prefix.py and must not be mistaken for hand-written
# source. Stage 2 includes it.
zephyr_library_include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# ZMK's own headers, for the stage-3 diagnostics that ask ZMK about its BLE
# profile and selected endpoint. ZMK exposes app/include to the app target only,
# so a module has to add it explicitly.
zephyr_library_include_directories(${ZEPHYR_BASE}/../app/include)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/kscan_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/pins_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/link_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/wdt_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/spim_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/saadc_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/mode_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/sleep_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_TWI src/twi_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_ZMK_BATTERY_REPORTING src/battery_bq_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_RGB src/rgb_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_RGB src/led_strip_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_RGB src/rgb_fx_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_RGB src/rgb_map_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_UART_EVIDENCE src/evidence_g4b.c)
# apex_control: shared control/telemetry API. Currently only the debug shell
# uses it; the Studio apex RPC subsystem will add its own condition later.
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SHELL src/apex_control_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SHELL src/apex_shell_g4b.c)
# The `apex` ZMK Studio RPC subsystem (heatmap etc.). Needs ZMK_STUDIO; gated
# with the shell build for now since it shares the apex_control API. It includes
# the nanopb-generated proto headers, which land in the app's binary dir (the top
# build dir) - the app target has that on its include path but this module does
# not, so add it explicitly.
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SHELL src/studio_apex_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_include_directories_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SHELL ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_GAMEPAD src/gamepad_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_DFU_TRIGGER src/dfu_trigger_g4b.c)
# Compiled for EVERY build of this board, not only gamepad builds. The keymap is
# shared by all seven stage images, so a behavior it references has to exist in
# all of them; when CONFIG_APEX_G4B_GAMEPAD is off the file resolves to stubs.
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/behavior_analog_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/behavior_actuation_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPIM_KSCAN src/behavior_dfu_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SW_RECOVERY src/recovery_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_USB_RECOVERY src/recovery_usb_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPINOR src/spinor_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_SPINOR_FLASHDEV src/flash_spinor_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_COREDUMP src/coredump_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_LITTLEFS src/littlefs_g4b.c)
# <zephyr/fs/littlefs.h> pulls in lfs.h, which lives in the littlefs module, not
# on this out-of-tree library's default include path (the in-tree fs subsystem
# gets it, we don't). Add the module dir when the substrate is enabled.
zephyr_include_directories_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_LITTLEFS ${ZEPHYR_LITTLEFS_MODULE_DIR})
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_UPDATER src/updater_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_AB_ROLLBACK src/ab_rollback_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_DONGLE_RADIO src/radio_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_ESB src/radio_esb_g4b.c)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_DONGLE_LINK src/dongle_link_g4b.c)

# s3_run_keyboard() has one call site. If a preprocessor edit removes that call,
# -Wunused-function is the only build-time warning. Promote it to an error for
# keyboard builds; diagnostic builds have intentionally unused functions.
if(CONFIG_APEX_G4B_STAGE EQUAL 3 AND CONFIG_APEX_G4B_KSCAN_INGEST)
  zephyr_library_compile_options(-Werror=unused-function)
endif()
